test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six babies are sitting around a circular dining table, facing the centre. Jo is an immediate neighbour of both Lucy and Stacy. Eva is sitting second to the right of Lucy. Keith is sitting third to the left of Stacy. Carol is an immediate neighbour of both Eva and Stacy. Who among the following is the immediate neighbour of both Jo and Carol?
solution:
Given, 

Six babies are sitting around a circular dining table, facing the centre.

Jo is an immediate neighbour of both Lucy and Stacy.

Eva is sitting second to the right of Lucy.

Keith is sitting third to the left of Stacy.

Carol is an immediate neighbour of both Eva and Stacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/138bccdc4becd3edd27440d6be282328c2a5893bd7822e15d6adbf35b7ddaa11.png] 

Stacy is the immediate neighbour of both Jo and Carol.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
